member.name: M:MT_PropertyExchange.FilePropIO2003.RunMacro(System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Execute a macro on an office document
member.remarks:
If an empty string is given as template, the procedure will sequentially try to load:
%ProgramFiles%\Siemens\MT\Office\plmUpdateServer.xla
Office library path\plmUpdateServer.xla
Office library path\vai\plmUpdateServer.xla
Office library path\mt\plmUpdateServer.xla
Office startup macro path\plmUpdateServer.xla
Office startup macro path\vai\plmUpdateServer.xla
Office startup macro path\mt\plmUpdateServer.xla
member.param: Full path to the office add-in (currently used only with Excel).
